description: This file defines a PHP class 'Currency' within the Opencart admin extension controller namespace. It handles listing, installation, and uninstallation of currency extensions, including loading associated languages, models, views, and managing permissions.

classes.name: Currency
classes.description: Controller class for managing currency extensions within the OpenCart admin panel, including listing, installation, and removal of currency modules.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Default method that outputs the list of currency extensions.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Generates and returns a view displaying available and installed currency extensions, their statuses, and links for management.

methods.name: install
methods.description: Handles the installation process of a currency extension including permission check, autoload setup, and optional installation routines.

methods.name: uninstall
methods.description: Handles the removal of a currency extension including permission verification and calling the extension's uninstall method.
